0022600087.text: The Charlotte Hornets visit the Brooklyn Nets with both teams opening their 2026-27 seasons, and Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee), all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 win in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026, in their most recent meeting. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Charlotte a 60% chance to win.
